jobs.title: SAF Regulatory/Environmental Specialist II
jobs.description:
Our client, a leading organization in the manufacturing and safety/environmental sector, is seeking a Regulatory/Environmental Specialist II to join their team. As a Regulatory/Environmental Specialist II, you will be part of the Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) department supporting operational safety and compliance initiatives. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, proactive communication, and a commitment to safety excellence, which will align successfully in the organization.

Job Title:
Regulatory/Environmental Specialist

Location:
Corona, California

Pay Range: $20 to $26 p/h on w-2

Duration: 12 month contract

What's the Job?

Conduct technical and project tasks within the safety and environmental fields to ensure project success.
Advise operations on EHS risks and controls to promote a safe working environment.
Initiate and complete activities leading to new or improved safety controls and procedures.
Engage in safety projects by collaborating with operations to define project parameters and desired outcomes.
Present and facilitate EHS training sessions, respirator fit testing, and inspection of IH results.

What's Needed?

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering sciences or related fields from an accredited institution.
3+ years of applicable EHS program management experience.
Strong knowledge of safety regulations, audit procedures, and environmental standards.
Ability to conduct inspections, audits, and investigations independently with minimal supervision.
Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with internal teams and external agencies.

What's in it for me?

Opportunity to work in a dynamic and safety-focused environment.
Engagement in meaningful projects that promote health and safety standards.
Collaborative work culture that values diversity and innovation.
Professional development and growth within a reputable organization.
Competitive schedule with standard working hours and potential for flexible adjustments.

Upon Completion Of Waiting Period Consultants Are Eligible For

Medical and Prescription Drug Plans
Dental Plan
Vision Plan
Health Savings Account
Health Flexible Spending Account
Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account
Supplemental Life Insurance
Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance
Business Travel Insurance
401(k), Plus Match
Weekly Pay

If this is a role that interests you and you'd like to learn more, click apply now and a recruiter will be in touch with you to discuss this great opportunity. We look forward to speaking with you!
